profile.headline: swe @ google | purdue alum
profile.summary:
Hello! I am a Software Engineer with 1+ years of combined internship and work experience in Software development. I have built full stack applications that aggregate and display over 28000 different health related data points and helped companies move 100TB+ of unstructured data to their data lake. I've conducted TensorFlow research with Google and lectured 900+ students on the fundamental tools of Computer Science.

Examples and bullet points of my work are listed in my experience section!

I get excited about opportunities where I can build meaningful products and develop new technologies!

I love connecting with new people, you can reach me at eddiekim1125@gmail.com or call me directly at 646-581-8829

I can’t wait to speak with you!

projects.title: DripDrop
projects.description:
Fashion is something many people struggle with, as stylish combinations may not be apparent at first and can be challenging to put together. DripDrop aims to assist in this struggle by providing a platform where users can share their outfits every day, receiving feedback about their style and also having a fun way of sharing their creativity with others. DripDrop would differ from other apps by focusing on user interaction on posts and incorporating a rating system to show what is seen as “top-tier outfits”. 


DripDrop seeks to address a struggle of fashion enthusiasts; one, creating stylish combinations and two, staying up with the current fashion trends. In the ever changing domain of fashion, DripDrop is targeted for users who have interests in both social media and fashion. By combining these aspects, users can not only showcase their personal style but also receive valuable feedback from the community. Our product adds an element of fun to the fashion-sharing experience, encouraging users to express their creativity and individuality. We want to focus on fostering user interaction through posts and incorporating a rating system to highlight and create competition to what is perceived as “top-tier outfits”
There are similar social media applications that we can compare with. Bereal for example is a social media platform that notifies users to take a picture everyday at that current time. Applications like Pinterest, Instagram, Facebook all allow users to upload and share photos for the community. What makes DripDrop different is the fashion focused ranking system where users will be ranked based on points they earn through voting.
The major limitation of other similar products is that other products have too much variety in photos and users. Because other platforms don’t have a clear focus on modeling and fashion, they are usually densely populated with pictures of random items or people. We wanted to create a space where fashion is the main focus.

projects.title: SimpleChat
projects.description:
SimpleChat is a simple way for people to communicate if they are on the same network. Create Accounts and new group chats with fellow coworkers or friends who are in the same network as you.

This whole program was created using Java and utilized Java's GUI, FileIO, Server and Client.
